docqa_rows.q: Where can ethidium bromide be used?
docqa_rows.answer: Ethidium bromide can be used in Bay 3 of the laboratory, as specified in the BIO 318 Laboratory Safety Procedures document. However, it is important to note that any spill larger than 500 mL necessitates evacuating the room and contacting extension 4410 immediately for proper handling (bio318_lab_safety.pdf, Chemical Handling, p.2).

docqa_rows.q: How large a spill requires evacuating the room?
docqa_rows.answer: A spill of ethidium bromide larger than 500 milliliters necessitates evacuating the laboratory room immediately and contacting extension 4410 for proper handling, as specified in the BIO 318 Laboratory Safety Procedures document under Chemical Handling (p.2).

docqa_rows.q: What extension should be called after a large spill?
docqa_rows.answer: After a large spill of ethidium bromide, it is necessary to evacuate the laboratory room and contact extension 4410 for proper handling. This information can be found in the BIO 318 Laboratory Safety Procedures document under Chemical Handling on page 2. (bio318_lab_safety.pdf, Chemical Handing, p.2)
